title: Classes and Actors
introduction: Classes combine state and behaviour, while Unreal reflection exposes selected members to engine systems.
learningOutcomes: Distinguish a class from an object instance.
Recognise the purpose of common Unreal reflection macros.
Describe the roles of an Actor constructor, BeginPlay and Tick.

activities.question: Which macro marks an Unreal class declaration for the reflection system?
activities.explanation: UCLASS marks the class, while UPROPERTY and UFUNCTION mark reflected members.

activities.question: Where should instance-dependent startup logic normally run for an Actor?
activities.explanation: BeginPlay runs when play begins for that Actor instance and is suitable for initialisation that depends on the world or other instances.
